packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts:317 — Same dead `find` fallback in deleteEvent: with a falsy externalCalendarId it silently falls back to "primary", and a 404 is swallowed as success, so events on a non-primary destination calendar are never deleted on cancel.

packages/core/EventManager.ts:512 — credential` is declared outside the loop and only reassigned when a DB lookup succeeds; if a reference's credentialId is not found (deleted credential), the stale credential from the previous host iteration is used to call updateEvent on a different host's calendar with the wrong uid.

packages/lib/CalendarService.ts:159 — CalDAV createEvent filters calendars by the first (main host) destination externalId; for a second collective host's credential nothing matches, `Promise.all([])` yields no failures, and it returns a success result with a uid despite creating no event (silent pass, bogus booking reference).

packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts:147 — In the no-credentialId branch of createAllCalendarEvents (`createEvent(c, event)` without externalId), the credentialId lookup finds nothing and the event is silently created on "primary" instead of the configured destination calendar, and the stored reference has no externalCalendarId.

packages/core/EventManager.ts:553 — When merging on reschedule (newBookingId), only the first old `_calendar` reference is deleted, leaving the other collective hosts' old calendar events orphaned on their calendars.

packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking.ts:1078 — If neither event type nor organizer has a destination calendar, `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null` and `?.push` silently drops all team members' destination calendars, so no host gets a calendar event.

packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts:449 — The recurring-cancel branch is now executed once per calendar reference, re-iterating every credential x every updated booking and only ever deleting the first `_calendar` ref of each, so other hosts' recurring events are never deleted while the first is deleted N times.

packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/confirm.handler.ts:175 — Confirm, Stripe/PayPal payment-success, and editLocation rebuild `evt.destinationCalendar` from only the booking/organizer calendar, so collective bookings that require confirmation or payment create calendar events only for the organizer (multi-host feature silently not applied).

packages/core/EventManager.ts:591 — Because updateEvent for a missing credential rejects, `Promise.all(result)` rejects and the catch marks every reference as failed even though other hosts' updates already succeeded (cascade misreport, no rollback).

packages/core/EventManager.ts:344 — Credentials fetched directly from DB by id are used without checking `invalid` or that the credential's userId is one of the booking's hosts; a stale/reassigned destination calendar credentialId writes events into an unrelated account.

packages/core/EventManager.ts:119 — mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration` is accessed without optional chaining, so a Google Meet booking with empty/null `destinationCalendar` throws TypeError instead of falling back to Cal Video.

packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts:256 — updateEvent fallback `find(cal => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)` only runs when `externalCalendarId` is falsy, so it can never match and the previous fallback to the destination calendar is lost (calendarId undefined).

packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts:315 — deleteEvent has the same always-undefined `find` fallback, silently deleting against "primary" instead of the destination calendar for references without externalCalendarId.

packages/app-store/larkcalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts:125 — Implementer ignores the new `credentialId` param and always targets `destinationCalendar[0]`, so for collective multi-host events the second host's credential writes to the main host's calendar id (wrong calendar / 404).

packages/lib/CalendarService.ts:125 — BaseCalendarService (CalDAV/Apple/etc.) createEvent ignores `credentialId` and filters calendars by `destinationCalendar[0].externalId`, so non-main hosts create nothing or write to the wrong calendar.

packages/core/EventManager.ts:380 — In the no-credentialId branch `createEvent(c, event)` is called without `externalId`, so the resulting booking reference `externalCalendarId` (line 169) is now undefined where it previously carried `destinationCalendar.externalId`; later update/delete fall back to primary.

packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking.ts:1067 — Producer sets `destinationCalendar: null` (all other producers emit `[]`), causing inconsistent webhook shapes (null for BOOKING_CREATED vs [] for BOOKING_REJECTED per webhook.e2e.ts:119/249) and making `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...)` at line 1075 silently drop team members' calendars when the organizer has none.

packages/core/EventManager.ts:380 — For collective bookings with several destinations lacking credentialId, each destination fans out to every credential of that integration type, creating duplicate calendar events per credential.
